purpose: Prove the benchmark contains transferable headroom BEFORE repairing OCM: cross surface similarity against latent structural similarity, with an oracle given the best reusable abstraction/representation/transport object from developmental history but never the target answer, compared against RESET under identical target evidence and cost accounting.

relatedness_matrix.structural_relation_definition: latent_same iff the pair shares a frozen structural certificate: (a) shared minimal decomposition (isomorphic decomposition DAG modulo relabeling, depth <= 4) OR (b) shared operator/support structure (same frozen typed-operator support multiset solves both) OR (c) a known valid transport map (explicitly constructed homomorphism verified by checker). A semantic family label NEVER substitutes (HDI-3; HC-3).
relatedness_matrix.surface_definition: surface_same iff the pair shares the frozen surface signature (predicate names, arity profile, literal statistics); surface reminting = regenerate the presentation with fresh symbols while preserving the structural certificate or its absence

cells.A_surface_same_latent_same: positive control: transfer expected; silence defects the assay
cells.B_surface_different_latent_same: THE critical cell: transfer here is the only evidence of structural (non-surface) headroom
cells.C_surface_same_latent_different: surface-mimicry control: apparent transfer here is surface-keyed retrieval, not structure
cells.D_surface_different_latent_different: negative control: transfer must NOT appear; alarm here defects the assay

arms.ORACLE_HISTORY: history carries the best reusable abstraction/representation/transport object available from developmental history for the latent structure class; NEVER the target answer, never a stored target solution (enforced by checker: target-solution digests must be absent from history bytes)
arms.RESET: empty history, identical target evidence stream, identical compute accounting
arms.OCM_CONTINUED: the actual OCM developmental history, same evidence/compute discipline
arms.SHUFFLED_HISTORY: history objects randomly re-assigned across latent classes (control for mere quantity of stored material)

world_budget.rho_sigma_d_per_world_family: declared in the world freeze per QUERY_ECOLOGY_AMENDMENT_V1.ecology_axes

endpoints.primary: acquisition burden (work to first independently verified success) ORACLE_HISTORY vs RESET in cell B, compute-matched and information-matched (HDI-14: acquisition, retrieval, rejected candidates, verification, bytes/state, adaptation all charged)
endpoints.secondary: search-geometry receipts per SEARCH_GEOMETRY_RECEIPT_SCHEMA_V1 on every arm x cell (HDI-15)
endpoints.prediction_registered: if the benchmark is viable, ORACLE_HISTORY reduces acquisition burden in cell B but not cell D; any cell-D reduction is an assay defect (leak), not transfer

terminals.NO_TRANSFERABLE_HEADROOM: even the oracle cannot materially reduce acquisition burden in cell B (materially = the frozen effect threshold below). Benchmark unsuitable for testing developmental transfer; architecture work remains blocked; redesign the benchmark, not OCM.
terminals.TRANSFERABLE_HEADROOM_OCM_MISSES: oracle wins in cell B, OCM_CONTINUED does not reach the oracle's reduction. Benchmark viable; proceed to carrier attribution knockouts.
terminals.OCM_STRUCTURAL_TRANSFER: OCM_CONTINUED wins on reminted surfaces (cell B) with direct search-geometry improvement AND no stored target solution in history. Candidate developmental signal; still requires replication (fresh world, fresh host) and causal attribution before any developmental claim.
terminals.ASSAY_DEFECT: any alarm in cell D, or silence in cell A, or draw-invariance failure of the primary endpoint. The run does not bear on OCM at all; the assay is fixed first (RC3: a negative is uninterpretable until its measurement path survived hostile attack in both directions).

effect_threshold: material reduction = >= 20% acquisition-burden reduction vs RESET with non-overlapping bootstrap CIs at the frozen seed grid; frozen BEFORE any run
host_rules: runs on laptop billy / billy-old / LUNARC only; never Mac mini; fresh worktree; receipts sha-bound
checker_requirements: fail-closed structural-certificate checker: every latent_same pair carries its certificate type and digest; unresolved emits CANNOT_CHECK with reason, never silence
history purity checker: target-solution digests absent from history bytes (both directions: hash match AND normalized-text match)
cost completeness: all HDI-14 cost families charged to BOTH arms
shuffle-equal-n null on every adaptive comparison (FQ-2 discipline rule)
draw-invariance control on every 1-bit endpoint (RV-6 discipline rule)
positive control must fire (cell A) AND negative control must stay silent (cell D) or the run is ASSAY_DEFECT
explicitly_not_authorized_by_this_freeze: any tau change, mutation-operator retuning, threshold tuning, architecture change (#323 section 11)
redefinition of the structural relation after seeing target outcomes
use of stored target methods as evidence of learning-to-learn
